en: Huh? Captain, what are you\nlooking at?

It is a TV show broadcasting on the
advanced planet that is our next
destination. They are showing live
footage of the Milky Quintet.
What!? Of us!?
Oh, it's footage from one of our\npast concerts.

It seems idol activities are very popular
in this star system, and they are
broadcasting a program featuring idols
who are popular in other systems.

I'm so happy that there are people
watching our videos and cheering us on
in a sector so far from the planet
where we performed.
Wait, is that a news flash...?

Romance revealed for the
popular space-faring idol group,
Milky Quintet... What is this
talking about!?
Captain, this is terrible! A huge\nscandal!!
...Wait, did something happen\nover here too?
There's a news report saying a\nromance has been revealed\nwithin the Milky Quintet!
What!? A scoop like that right\nunder our noses!?
Of course not! It's fake news,\ncompletely fake!
This photo... it's from when we\nall went shopping together.

They've gone to the trouble of
cropping it to show only the
part where you're with the
Captain.
True, if someone only saw this,\nthey might actually\nmisunderstand...
A fake scandal article, huh...\nThis smells fishy too.

Oh, as for my news, there have been
frequent reports of girls disappearing
on our destination, the advanced planet
Twinkle Dust.
Girls disappearing!?

I don't have all the details yet,
but apparently there's a
common thread among the
missing girls.
They were all "successful\napplicants for an Idol\nAudition"...

Could it be that someone is
trying to hold an idol concert
for themselves, just like Head
Bull did...!

We cannot simply ignore this. We were
already planning to resupply on this
planet, so shall we investigate the
situation locally?
But if we end up getting\nkidnapped like last time, it'll all\nbe for nothing.
But we won't find anything if\nwe just stay here. Let's send a\nsmall group to investigate!

Male Fan: ...So, you've already
heard the new <font color=yellow>GNG48</font> song,
right? My favorite member was
absolutely amazing.

Female Fan: Who hasn't heard
it? Milky Quintet wasn't bad,
but GNG is definitely where it's
at these days!
...I see. It looks like an idol\ngroup called GNG48 is popular\nhere.

If we want to verify the rumors about
the idols, talking to the fans would be
the fastest way. For now, let's look into
the most popular group, GNG48.
Haggard Man: Are you all\nlooking into GNG?
Huh... and you are?

Haggard Man: Sorry for speaking to
you so abruptly. I'm not anyone
suspicious. Actually, I've been
researching GNG myself.

Haggard Man: My daughter is in GNG...
but she left to perform a concert near
where the interplanetary conflict is
happening, and I haven't heard from her
since.
You haven't heard from her?!\nAnd what do you mean, a\nconcert near a conflict zone?!

Haggard Man: My daughter said it was
part of a visit to comfort the soldiers...
but I'm so worried that she might have
been caught up in the fighting...

Haggard Man: Oh, I've contacted the
agency too. But they just keep insisting
they can't give me any details to
prevent the girls' schedules from
leaking.

I see... that is worrying. We're in the
middle of investigating as well. I'll give
you my contact info. Let's exchange
information if we find anything.
Thank you. But that agency is\nplagued by unsettling rumors.\nPlease, be careful.
Yes, I know. You take care as\nwell.
Ah, there you are! Captain,\nChisato, I've looked into a few\nthings!

Apparently, an idol group called
GNG48 is popular on this
planet, and their agency seems
to hold a lot of power.
But that agency, <font color=yellow>Beyond Over\nProduction</font>, doesn't seem to\nhave a very good reputation.

There are rumors that they
hold leverage over rival idol
groups, or that they just
recruit any girl they can find.
It's possible that what\nhappened to Milky Quintet was\nthe work of this agency...

Thank you both. GNG48 and
their agency, Beyond Over
Production, definitely seem
suspicious.

Still, idol activities are really
thriving on Twinkle Dust. No
matter where you go, there are
girls performing on the streets.

With songs and smiles everywhere, it
really is a wonderful planet. Seeing
them work so hard somehow gives me
energy.
Ah! That's actually something I\nwas curious about.

When I hear them sing, I feel
this surge of energy from
within. It's almost like...
Symbology...
Spot on, Miki!
Hey! You scared me, jumping\ninto the comms like that!
Ah, my apologies! I just got a\nbit carried away...

After analyzing the songs, it seems the
women of this planet can use a special
form of Symbology that enhances
others' physical abilities through song.
Magic through song... they're\nalmost like the people of the\nFox Soul...

They're gathering girls indiscriminately.
We can't reach the GNG48 members
who went to the comfort concert. Their
songs possess Symbology power.
I think the key to solving this\ncase is around here.

You're right. For the sake of your
worried father, I'll first investigate the
conflict zone where the girls went for
the comfort concert!
Male Fan: ...Hey. Is that...\nsomeone from the Milky\nQuintet over there?
Oh no! We've been spotted!?
A-Anyway, let's get out of here\nbefore a crowd forms!

This is the analysis footage of
the sector where the conflict is
occurring. Seeing this, it really
is as we feared...
I can't believe something like\nthis is actually happening...!
Captain, everyone. You're back\nalready.
I heard you went to investigate\na strange incident on a planet\ncalled Twinkle Dust.
...So, you're saying Beyond\nOver Production has been\nkidnapping girls?

Yes. It seems the girls who become
idols are sent to interplanetary conflict
zones under the guise of being a
musical troupe to provide combat
support.

Furthermore, to prevent the information
from leaking, the girls are placed in an
environment where they cannot contact
the outside world...

It looks like the scandal was just a
fabrication to crush other idol groups
and concentrate all the girls in their
own agency.

We won't be staying in this
sector for long. The scandal is
one thing, but the real problem
is the members of GNG.
Right. That's why I think we\nshould try talking to the GNG\ngirls first.
Are you able to get in touch\nwith the idols?
It's okay! Chisato, who is still\ninvestigating on-site, looked\ninto it for me.

Coro, please contact the
members of GNG48. Use a
secure line so the production
company doesn't find out.
Understood! Opening the line\nnow!

Hello, can you hear me? This is
the exploration combat ship
GFSS-3214F, currently docked
at Twinkle Dust.
GNG48 Member: "Huh? Who is\nthis? This line is for members\nonly..."
GNG48 Member: "Wait... are\nyou perhaps from the Milky\nQuintet...?"

Yes. There is something I
absolutely need you to know,
which is why I'm contacting
you.

To put it bluntly, I want all of
you in GNG48 to quit the
group and run away
immediately.
GNG48 Member: "What...!\nW-what are you talking\nabout?!"

Beyond Over Production is trying to
exploit your unique symbol arts. If you
stay, you could be forced to take part
in a conflict!

GNG48 Member: "...Who do you think
you are, calling us out of the blue and
saying this! No one is going to believe
such a wild story!!"

Calm down and listen! Haven't
any of your members gone
missing or stopped
responding? Think carefully!
GNG48 Member: "T-that's..."
My, my, my! I thought I heard\nsome commotion... you're from\nthe Milky Quintet, aren't you?
You...!
GNG48 Producer: "Greetings. I\nam the general producer for\nGNG48."

GNG48 Producer: "This is quite
problematic. Just because you've been
hit by a scandal, you try to crush your
business rivals."
I wonder which one of us is\nactually doing that?

GNG48 Producer: "I have no idea what
you're talking about, but if you're so
concerned about GNG, why don't we
settle this on stage like proper idols?"

GNG48 Producer: "A festival
showdown where the fame and
the very existence of our
groups are on the line."
Existence...
Fine, you're on!

GNG48 Producer: "What a
wonderful response. I look
forward to the day of the
festival. Ha ha ha ha!"
...Everyone, I'm sorry. I got\ncarried away and agreed to\nthe festival.
No, Eve, you were so cool!

Besides, the Milky Quintet was formed
as idols to protect everyone from
unreasonable power. Now is the time to
stand up!

They've already realized we are
making a move. We had no
choice but to accept the
challenge.
However, now that it's come to\nthis, the scandal will likely take\na toll.
You're right. I wonder if the\nfans will continue to support us\nas they always have...
Hmm, a sister unit for the Milky\nQuintet, then?
Well, forming a new unit is the\nbest way to generate buzz. But\nwho will be the members?
Could I help out with that too?

Using the songs of girls who sing as
idols as tools for combat... I can't stand
by and let them be exploited and
dragged into a conflict!
Exploiting... their power...
Right, Karlyn, you feel the\nsame way, don't you?
I suppose so... As a survivor of\nthe Fox Soul people, I won't let\nsuch a tragedy happen again.
Then it's settled! Karlyn, you're\ngoing to be an idol with us!
Me, an idol with Tika!?
That's impossible! There's no\nway I could wear a cute outfit\nand smile for a crowd.
That's not true! You're a great\nsinger and you're beautiful, so\nit's perfect!

It's all about taking on new
challenges, Karlyn. You said
yourself the other day that it
was time to try something new.

I was talking about things like
piloting the ship, not becoming
an idol... I've never even
considered it...
Karlyn... please? You really\ncan't?
...Fine, I'll do it. But only to\nprotect everyone in GNG48.
Ehehe, then it's settled! We're\nmaking our idol debuts!

Now that it's decided, let the
lessons begin! The Milky
Quintet will work together to
turn you two into idols!
I can't believe it's already time\nfor the live show... I'm starting\nto get nervous!

We've learned everything
necessary to be idols. Now, all
that's left is to step onto the
stage.
Right...!
GNG48 Member: So you're the\nsister unit of the Milky\nQuintet?

GNG48 Member: It seems like
you're trying to get us to
disband, but we can't let a
group like yours beat us!
You might not see it now, but\nstaying with GNG will only lead\nto more pain.
That's why we're going to win\nright here, right now...!
Our live show was way more\nexciting, so let the GNG48 girls\ngo!

GNG48 Producer: Alright, good
work today. As of now, the
GNG third-string team is
disbanded.
GNG48 Member: Producer, you\ncan't...!
Third-string... what does that\nmean?

GNG48 Producer: It means
they're just little chicks,
nowhere near the level of the
first-string center class.
Then we'll just have to beat\nthe first-string. Bring those\ngirls here immediately.

GNG48 Producer: Unfortunately, they
are quite busy. First, prove that you
have the skill to beat the second-string.
Until next time.
Look at this crowd! So this is a\nGNG Event...!
I see there's more to being an\nidol than just standing on a\nstage.
I know. We're here to figure out\nwhat we're lacking.
Captain, look over there!\nThere's a huge line, I wonder\nwhat they're doing?
Huh, so it's called a handshake\nevent.
I didn't realize idols got to\ninteract with their fans from\nsuch a close distance.
The fans and the GNG girls\nlook like they're having so\nmuch fun talking!

I bet hearing words of support
directly from the people who
cheer for them gives them so
much energy.
Yes...
(Do the members of GNG truly\nenjoy being idols from the\nbottom of their hearts...?)

(For those girls, GNG is a place
where they can make people
smile. If that's the case, then
we should...)
Big sister Karlyn? What's\nwrong?
...No. It's nothing.

Really? The Captain says
they've seen enough, so it's
time to head back. Come on,
let's go!
So Rena and Fayt will be\nleading today's lesson.

Yeah, looking forward to it.
Since I'm the teacher, I'm going
to be strict, so make sure you
keep up.
You're already learning the\nbasics of being an idol from\nVerda and the others, right?

That's why we're going to
practice Live MCing, which is
essential for getting the crowd
hyped up!

I see. The GNG members were great at
getting everyone excited during the
handshake event. We won't be able to
win the festival unless we can do even
better than that.
Exactly! Now, I'll show you how\nit's done.
Everyone! Thank you so much\nfor coming to see us today!!
Wow... it's like I can actually\nhear the cheering.
Hehe, thanks.

To get the crowd excited, you have to
enjoy yourselves too! Try it out, and
imagine that you're actually on the Live
Stage.
Um... Everyone! Thank you so,\nso much for coming to see us\ntoday!!
...Everyone! Thank you for\ncoming!
Yep, Tika, you nailed it! You\nmight even be better than me\nalready.
Y-you think so...? I'm so happy.

Karlyn, your cool demeanor is your
selling point, but you still need more
energy if you want your voice to reach
the fans. Don't be shy!
It's not that I'm shy... Fine, I'll\ntry it one more time.
Hehe. Good luck, Big Sister\nKarlyn!
Tika, don't act so confident.\nI've heard Karlyn is way better\nat singing and dancing.
Wah...! Y-yes!
Alright, we're running out of\ntime, so let's keep moving!

GNG48 Member: Everyone!
You're all going to give it your
all and get hyped for our show
today, right?!
Audience: YEAAAAAH!!
The GNG girls are amazing at\nMCing...! I can feel the whole\nvenue becoming one.
Yes...

GNG48 Member: GNG will never break
up, because we want to keep seeing all
of you at our shows! So please, give us
all the support you've got!

(Those girls are just desperate to
protect the place where they belong...
Just like I fought desperately to
protect the home of the
Kitsunetamashii people...)
Oh, it's our turn! Let's go!
(No, I can't let my mind wander.\nI have to focus on the stage.)
One, two, three, four! One, two,\nthree...
Stop!
I think Karlyn might have been\nrushing a bit during that last\npart.
You're a unit, so you have to\nstay in sync with Tika.
I'm sorry... could we try it one\nmore time?

Oh, before that... our next festival
match is against the first-string
members, so I think we need a precise
performance.

I think it would help if you paid
more attention to each other's
movements and what the other
is thinking.
Yes, that's right. It's not good\nto overdo it, so why don't we\ntake a short break?
*Sigh*...
Karlyn, can I talk to you for a\nsecond?
Yes. Is this about that part\nfrom earlier?
Oh, no! Not that. I just\nwondered if something was\nbothering you.
That's not it. I'm just not used\nto being an idol yet. There's\njust a lot on my mind.

But ever since we went to see
the GNG48 Event, you've
seemed troubled every now
and then, right?
...You noticed, didn't you?
Ehehe, well, we are in the same\nunit!
...Tell me, Tika. Do you really\nthink disbanding GNG is the\nright solution?
Huh...?

Of course it is! If we don't free
them, their Symbol Arts will
just be forced into being tools
for conflict!
That is obviously unacceptable.\nBut...
Those girls were active\nspecifically to bring smiles to\nthe people who needed them.
Even the girls called "second-string" or\n"third-string" practiced desperately for\ntheir fans to put on Events and lives.
And yet, I've stolen their\nfuture... I've taken away the\nplace where they belonged.
Sister Karlyn...
In the future... in Daftine, where\nyou used to live...
I wonder if the people of the\nFox Soul are living in peace?
That's...
Or perhaps... the words "Fox\nSoul" don't exist anywhere\nanymore.
...To you, Big Sister Karlyn,\neveryone in GNG48 is just like\nthe people of the Fox Soul.

The Fox Soul people... were
needed by Givel and Baschen's
people because they had
strong Crest power.

Everyone in GNG became idols
because they had special
Crest power, and they give
strength to their fans.
Being needed is a precious\nthing. That fact becomes the\nplace where you belong.
I understand that feeling.\nBecause that's how everyone\non this ship is for me.

But that's exactly why I don't
want them to stay in a fake
place like GNG48, which was
only made for military use.

It's true that GNG might be a fake
place created for another purpose, but
the cheers from the fans are real. They
truly support them.
Yeah, that's why I think it'll be\nokay.
What do you mean, "it'll be\nokay"...?
The girls of GNG48 work so\nhard just to live up to their\nfans' expectations.
I'm sure they'll be able to find a\nplace where they truly belong,\nthrough their own strength.

...You're right, Tika. A place to
belong isn't something provided
for you; it's something you
seek out yourself.
Yeah! Just like how you and I\nfound our place on this ship,\nKarlyn!
...We've taken quite a long\nbreak. Shall we head back to\npractice?
Tika. Let's make sure we win\nthe next festival, too.
Yeah...!
Everyone, thank you so much\nfor coming to our show today!
We're going to give you a\nperformance you'll never\nforget... are you ready?
Audience: YEEEEEAH!!
This street live was a huge\nsuccess! You two were\namazing!
I got so nervous when I\nrealized how many people had\ngathered...!
Hehe... I never imagined the\nday would come when so many\npeople would listen to us sing.
A unit performing at a festival\nwith GNG's top tier is bound to\nget a lot of attention.
It looks like a lot of people\nbecame fans of yours after\nseeing today's show!

They're even calling you the new stars
following in the footsteps of Milky
Quintet. You've both become such
wonderful idols!
Wonderful idols... I never\ndreamed things would turn out\nlike this.
I'm so glad I get to be an idol\nwith Karlyn!
I think today's stage was so\nmuch fun because I was with\nyou!
You're right, it was fun...
...Are you still worried about\nthe GNG girls?

I'm sorry... It's just that when I
think about how they're
enjoying the stage too, I can't
help it.
But what I need to do now is\nguide them back to where they\nbelong...
Karlyn. An idol shouldn't be\nmaking such a scary face.

Think back carefully to today's
live show. A huge crowd came
just to see the two of you
perform, right?

Everyone is cheering for you because
they want to see you smile. So, for the
sake of your fans, you must never
forget to smile!
You're right... We are idols,\nafter all.

Freeing them is an important
goal, but I also have to bring
the brightest smiles to the
people who became our fans.
Ehehe... I'm looking forward to\nseeing your best smile too, big\nsister!
Hehe, you can count on it.
GNG48 Center: Oh, so you\nactually showed up instead of\nrunning away.
Of course I came. There are\nfans here waiting for us.

GNG48 Center: Hmph, your
spirit is admirable, I'll give you
that. Fine, I'll show you the
difference in our levels!
Wow... Their singing and\ndancing are on a whole\ndifferent level...!
So this is their true strength.\nBut... something feels off.
Huh? What's wrong, Karlyn?
Stop!! They have to stop\nsinging right now! Otherwise,\nsomething terrible will happen!!
Kyaa! What's going on?! This\nhas never happened in any of\ntheir previous shows!!

They must be resonating with the
Center girl's emotions, causing their
Symbol Arts to run wild. If this
continues, it'll be a disaster...

GNG48 Producer: Ha ha ha ha!
Splendid, simply splendid! More,
more, more! Let those
emotions overflow!
You!

GNG48 Producer: I should thank you. I
managed to gather girls who could use
arts, but I was struggling to find a way
to draw out their full power.
GNG48 Center: The singing,\nthe dancing... it's so powerful...!\nI can win... I want to win...!

GNG48 Producer: I never imagined
things would go exactly as planned!
With this power, the clients will surely
be satisfied! Muhahaha!
Sister Karlyn! The other girls'\nSymbol Arts power is being\ngathered into the center girl!
Stop singing this instant!\nOtherwise, your body won't be\nable to take it!
GNG48 Center: I won't... hand\nthis stage over... to people like\nyou...
GNG48 Center: I won't let\nANYONE... take it away!
It's no use, she can't hear us!

(That stench of the Symbol...!
This feeling is exactly like when
those children transformed into
monsters!!)
Male Fan: Aaaaaahhh!
Female Fan: ...W-what's\nhappening...? H-help me...
GNG48 Center: ...!!
I'll handle the evacuation of the\naudience! Karlyn, Tika, please\ntake care of the GNG girls!!
GNG48 Center: A... aaa... N-no...
GNG48 Center: No... stop...\nEveryone... run...
(That's right. No matter what\nhappens, you are idols. You\ncan't let your fans suffer.)
(If your hearts are still in there,\nwe can fight this together!!)
Sorry, but this festival is\ncancelled!
GNG48 Center: Ugh... no...\nstop...
Sister!
Yes, we can still save them! We\nhave to suppress the magic's\nrampage!

Announcer: "Regarding the incident
where GNG48 members experienced
abnormalities during their live
performance, it appears their agency
may have known something..."
People are still talking about\nthat concert.

I think it's also because Chisato
published an expose with a significant
amount of evidence immediately after
the incident.

Everyone must have been shocked to
learn that while they appeared to be an
idol agency, they were secretly plotting
to use idols for military purposes.

The crowd of fans at the venue are the
best witnesses of all. Beyond Over
Production won't be able to wiggle out
of this.
So, will the idols all go back to\ntheir normal lives?

It looks like the agency is folding, but
there were reports that the top
members are starting a new agency to
continue their activities.
Having to start all over again...\nthat sounds tough.
I'm sure those girls will be fine.\nBecause...
The reaction from the Symbol\nArts has stopped... It won't run\nwild again, right?

No. The other girls' singing has
stopped, and this girl is completely
exhausted... She shouldn't be able to
move for a while.
GNG48 Center: Ugh... the\nfans... are they... okay? No\none... got hurt...?
...Yes. Everything is fine. No\none else will be hurt, thanks to\nall your hard work.
So, you should get some rest\nnow.
GNG48 Center: I see... thank\ngoodness...

...The GNG48 are the best
idols, because they truly care
for their fans from the bottom
of their hearts.

You're right. This incident might leave a
lasting impression, but if they continue
as idols with sincerity, I'm sure they'll
be popular again.
Even without any special\npowers, their performances\nwere truly energizing.
Yes... I feel the same way.

Now we just hope something
can be done about the fake
news regarding the Milky
Quintet.

They say rumors fade with
time. If they keep a low profile
until things cool down, it should
settle itself.
As for the Milky Quintet\nscandal, look here. It's already\nbeen retracted as a hoax!
This article... did you write this,\nChisato?

I put some pressure on the executive
director of Beyond Over Production.
Given the circumstances, they
retracted it without any fuss.
Not just the expose, but you\neven got our scandal\nretracted... Not bad, Chisato!

While you all were working hard as
idols, the Captain was running around
raising funds to establish a new
production company.
Captain, when did you have\ntime for that?! You were\nalways there for our lessons!

The Captain said we couldn't let our
own circumstances or the company's
problems take away their place to
belong. Right, Captain?
(...So the Captain felt the same\nway I did when looking at those\ngirls.)
Hehe, it's nothing. Just... well...
I just realized that this is it...\nthis ship, where the Captain is,\nis where I truly belong.
A lot happened, but it looks\nlike everything's finally settled!
I guess so. I guess being an\nidol is over now.
Are you sad?
Yeah. I really loved standing on\nstage with you, big sister.
It feels a bit lonely for us too,\nknowing this is the last time\nwe'll see you two on stage.
You two were really starting to\nlook the part of idols.
It would be so cool if we could\nall perform on the same stage\nsomeday!
That sounds lovely. The Milky\nQuintet, Tika, Karlyn, Fayt, and\nRena, all together.
Thinking about it this way, it's\nclear the Captain has trained\nquite a few idols!

Do not be so humble. Our
success as idols is entirely
thanks to the Captain's
leadership.

If more and more idols join us,
the Captain might even create
a massive idol group like
GNG48 one day.
Haha... that would certainly be\none heck of a show.
But it sounds so exciting!
If our songs are ever needed\nagain, I'd love for all of us to\nstand on stage together.
And of course, we'll still be\ntogether then, Big Sister\nKarlyn.

You're right... being idols is one of the
places where we belong. It might be
nice to sing for someone's sake again
someday.

This concludes the current
story. More stories will be
released in the future, so
please look forward to them.
